title: General three-bit laws: rotations of the wave and implication laws
claim: For general three-bit laws with complex weights on the level-k Sierpinski gaskets: in the generic stratum (two sectors u1 v1 y1 + u2 v2 y2 with each pair independent), level 2 holds iff the diagonal products agree and the vanishing cross pairings cover a hexagon, whose minimal covers are three of size four (pair-symmetric laws, reduced to WAVE-UNIQUENESS-20261029-001A by a symmetry of the gasket) and two of size three (the cyclic branch u2 = J v1, v2 = J y1, y2 = J u1 and its mirror); on the cyclic branch, level 2 is c^2 = 1 and level 3 holds iff a first-sector vector is a coordinate vector, which gives the implication laws e0 v y + Jv Jy e1 (support a = 1 implies c = 1; twelve types), exact at every level with factor <v, y>^(k-1) (v0 y0)^(m_k) by a closure argument on the sectors. Laws of rank one in a corner give products and u(a)[b = c] up to rotation. Hence in these strata the laws exact at levels 2 to 5 are the images of the symmetric classes, the implication laws and the products, and the only knots among them are the rotations of signed not-all-equal. The stratum of vanishing hyperdeterminant with full multilinear rank is not classified.
failure_conditions: A generic or slot-rank-one law exact at levels 2 to 5 outside the stated classes.
An implication law that fails exactness at some level.
A symbolic identity, Groebner basis or factorization that does not reproduce.
foundation_claim_scope: General three-bit laws with complex weights on level-k Sierpinski gaskets; exactness of the corner relation; the knot status of supports.
